name: Mutanus the Devourer
summary: Mutanus the Devourer is a monstrous, pale murloc manifested directly from the Emerald Nightmare. Lurking in the darkest recesses of the sleeping druid Naralex's mind, it emerges to devour anyone attempting to break the Nightmare's hold over the Wailing Caverns. Slaying this twisted aberration is the final step in freeing Naralex from his tormented slumber.

sections.title: A Dreamer's Worst Fear
sections.body: When the night elf druid Naralex tapped into the underground springs beneath the Barrens, he aimed to restore life to the arid wastes by connecting them to the Emerald Dream. Instead, an ancient corruption known as the Emerald Nightmare invaded his thoughts. Trapped in an agonizing vision, Naralex's subconscious fears took physical form. The corruption seized upon a bizarre, primal revulsion in the druid's psyche—his deep-seated terror of murlocs—and amplified it into an immense, albino predator.

sections.title: The Waking Nightmare
sections.body: Mutanus was sent forth into the waking world by the dark force infesting Naralex's mind, tasked with ensuring the druid never awakens. When a Disciple of Naralex performs the ritual to revive their master, Mutanus breaches the boundary between dream and reality. Along with his unnatural form, he brings alien relics from the dreamscape, such as the mysterious Deep Fathom Ring. Until Mutanus falls, Naralex remains a prisoner of his own corrupted imagination.

aliases: what kind of creature is mutanus
faq.answer: Mutanus the Devourer is an enormous, pale murloc-like aberration born from the Emerald Nightmare. He is not a normal denizen of Azeroth, but a living nightmare summoned into reality from the corrupted mind of the sleeping druid Naralex.

faq.q: Why does Mutanus look like a giant murloc?
faq.answer: The Nightmare twisted Naralex's subconscious thoughts and drew out his worst personal enemy: murlocs. The corruption weaponized that deep-seated fear, manifesting it as a colossal albino monstrosity.

faq.q: Why does Mutanus appear at the end of the ritual?
faq.answer: The dark presence corrupting the Emerald Dream ordered Mutanus to prevent anyone from breaking Naralex's slumber. When Naralex's disciples begin the awakening ritual, Mutanus crosses over into the physical cavern to devour the rescuers.

Mutanus originates from the Emerald Nightmare, the corrupted realm that has ensnared Naralex. Crossing over from the dreamscape into Azeroth, he even brought along strange relics like the Deep Fathom Ring.
Yes. Once Mutanus is slain, the nightmare's immediate hold over Naralex's mind is shattered, allowing his disciples to successfully awaken the druid and break the cavern's dark trance.

faq.q: Why is Mutanus immune to shadow magic?
faq.answer: Mutanus is an aberration woven from dark nightmare energies, making him naturally resilient against necrotic and shadow spells that would harm mundane beasts.

angles.text: Mutanus represents the terrifying hazards of delving too deeply into the Emerald Dream without safeguards, as a fellow druid's mind was completely overtaken by corruption.
For the kaldorei, Mutanus is a tragedy brought to life, embodying how Naralex's noble ambitions to heal the Barrens warped into a monstrous nightmare.
The Horde cannot allow Mutanus and the Nightmare to corrupt the heart of the Barrens, threatening the vital oasis waters needed to sustain Durotar and Mulgore.
